reviews.text: We lost a number of trees during the July 4 wind storm. After having the trees removed we received stump grinding quotes from several companies. We are very pleased that we chose Eager Beaver! I can’t recommend Jim and Eager Beaver Stump Removal enough!
reviews.author: Dave J.

reviews.text: Excellent service from start to finish! Arrived right on time, worked efficiently, and delivered professional results at a very fair price. It's refreshing to find someone who takes pride in their work and does exactly what they promise. Highly recommend!
